title: Effect of polar organic solvents on the separation of rare earths and transition metal chloride complexes: comparison of ion exchange, extraction chromatography and solvent extraction
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,18419-18429
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00908A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Brecht Dewulf, Koen Binnemans
Ion exchangers are less prone to losses of extractant in polar organic solvents compared to extraction chromatography resins and solvent extraction systems, and yet retain the same selectivity towards transition metals and/or rare-earth elements.
